plan.title: Docs: explain what verification runs, why it is slow, and how to choose a project's local gates
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

metadata.sizeJustification: Four doc files, one subsystem (docs). The four PIPELINE-GATES.md items are a shared-mutation chain on one file.

narratives.Problem: docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md says verification runs a fixed 'typecheck, lint, test' list, never lists the real steps, and never explains the machine-wide CPU admission queue that made seven concurrent verifications take 50+ minutes each on 2026-10-24. configuration/projects.mdx does not document the quality_gates block. docs/CONFIGURATION.md repeats the stale fixed list. Nothing tells an operator which gates to keep locally when CI already runs them.
narratives.Proposal: Docs-only change, written from the verified facts F1-F5 in .pan/drafts/PAN-4609.md. In docs/PIPELINE-GATES.md, rewrite the Verification Gate opening and add three subsections directly after it (before '### One full-suite run per push'): 'What a verification run does' (the 15 steps of runVerificationForIssueInProcess in code order), 'Why verification is slow' (admission thresholds, FIFO, per-gate re-queue, Vitest sharing the queue, nice -n 19, CPUWeight, logged times include queue wait, how to read worker logs), and 'Choosing a project's local gates' (keep what CI does not run; Overdeck example; CI FAILED tradeoff). Add a '### Quality gates' reference with all 12 QualityGateConfig keys to configuration/projects.mdx. Fix the stale sentence in docs/CONFIGURATION.md. Merge main, re-verify every citation with git grep, run npm run lint:docs.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to any source, test, script, role prompt, CI workflow or config file (src/, tests/, scripts/, roles/, .github/, projects.yaml).
- No change to the tracked example projects.yaml text in src/lib/projects.ts.
- No description of PAN-4546 or PAN-4531 internals beyond one sentence each.
- No edit to the PAN-3965 bullets, the 'Agent Auto-Resume Gates' section, or any subsection another open PR (#4599, #4602, #4604, #4608) adds.
- No instruction telling the reader to delete owner.json, waiter files or ~/.overdeck/verification-workers/.
- No recommendation to remove an install gate; the docs state what it adds and leave the choice to the reader.
- No OKF bundle (../overdeck-knowledge) edit.

narrative.Action: Follow PRD work item W3 using facts F2, F3 and F4. Insert '### Why verification is slow' directly after the W2 subsection. Cover, in this order: (1) one machine-wide admission holder, FIFO waiters, a separate admission for every gate and every retry attempt; (2) the pressure rule: CPU utilization >= 0.75, or PSI some avg10 >= 25, or (only without PSI) load per core >= 1, plus the 1 s poll and the 1.5 s settle re-sample that gives the slot back; (3) direct agent-shell Vitest runs share the queue via the tests/vitest-cpu-admission.ts globalSetup (30-minute max wait; skipped when OVERDECK_GATE_ADMITTED=1, OVERDECK_GATE_ADMISSION=0 or CI is set); (4) local gates run under nice -n 19 and the worker runs in a systemd scope with CPUWeight=resources.verification_cpu_weight (default 20); (5) the 'passed (Nms)' time and artifact durationMs include queue wait and retries because runQualityGates takes startTime before acquireQualityGateAdmission; (6) limits: 20-minute per-attempt GATE_TIMEOUT_MS, 65-minute MAX_RUN_MS counted from first admission, stale holder cleared after 25 minutes or a dead pid (no manual deletion); (7) the ungated install step and the second run at merge time; (8) the PAN-4546 / PAN-4531 sentence exactly per PRD D9 (if either PR has merged and added its own paragraph, link it). End with a 'Reading the logs' part: the path ~/.overdeck/verification-workers/<issue>/worker-<runId>.log, a fenced text example of the Queued / Admitted / passed lines, how to compute queue time and run time from them, the state.json fields phase, admittedAt, currentGate, currentAttempt, and the admission/ directory (owner.json = holder, waiter-*.json = queue).

narrative.Action: Follow PRD work item W4 using fact F5. Insert '### Choosing a project's local gates' directly after the W3 subsection and before '### One full-suite run per push, on CI (PAN-3965)'. Write: (1) the rule — a local gate that repeats a required CI check only repeats it under the single admission slot; keep locally what CI does not run or what must fail before review starts; (2) the maintainers' Overdeck gate set as a YAML fence (install: bun install --frozen-lockfile; typecheck: npm run typecheck; test: changed-file vitest with retry: 1, deferred to CI in ci mode), labelled as the per-machine projects.yaml the maintainers run (PRD D6); (3) why lint, build, frontend-typecheck and server-bundle were dropped: npm run build runs scripts/build-post-cli.mjs, which includes build:dashboard:server:bundle (the server bundle) and build:dashboard:frontend (strict tsc && vite build); npm run typecheck already includes typecheck:frontend, which is a baseline ratchet (scripts/lint-frontend-types.sh), not the strict build tsc; CI's build, lint-group and test jobs run them; (4) the install note per PRD D7: the runner's built-in install is warn-only, so an install gate adds a failing lockfile check; (5) the tradeoff: a lint or build failure then appears as a red CI check after review starts; relayCiFailureFeedbackInQueue in cloister/ci-failure-feedback.ts sends a live work agent a plain 'CI FAILED' message, it is not counted against VERIFICATION_MAX_CYCLES, and the merge gate still requires the checks green.
